## 🌟 What is GemsRock?

**GemsRock** is a fully on-chain mystery box protocol combining an ERC-20 reward token (**GEMS**) with 12 unique ERC-721 **IceBox NFTs**. Each IceBox is a sealed treasure chest — mint it, trade it sealed, or open it to reveal a prize drawn from the on-chain reward pool.

Every opening is provably fair: the prize tier is determined by a cryptographic seed assigned at mint time and revealed only when `openBox()` is called. No off-chain randomness, no admin control over outcomes — pure blockchain truth.

---

## 🪙 GEMS Token — ERC-20

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| **Name** | GemsRock Token |
| **Symbol** | `GEMS` |
| **Standard** | ERC-20 |
| **Contract** | `0x49931887171BF46922b2b80Aa834537A80C50B70` |
| **Supply** | 3 independent pools |
| **Decimals** | 18 |

### Supply Pools
```
MAX_SUPPLY
├── PUBLIC_SUPPLY    → circulating / DEX / community
├── OWNER_RESERVE    → team, partnerships, marketing  
└── BOX_REWARD_POOL  → IceBox prize payouts only
```
The **Box Reward Pool** is a dedicated reserve exclusively for rewarding box openers. When a box is opened, `rewardFromPool(address, amount)` is called automatically, sending GEMS instantly to the opener's wallet.

## 🔧 Smart Contract Reference

### GEMS Token — Key Functions

| Function | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `rewardFromPool(address, uint256)` | IceBox only | Sends GEMS prize to opener |
| `ownerMint(address, uint256)` | Owner | Mint from owner reserve |
| `setIceBoxContract(address)` | Owner | Link the IceBox contract |
| `transfer / transferFrom` | Public | Standard ERC-20 |

### IceBox NFT — Key Functions

| Function | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mint()` | Public (payable) | Mint random box type |
| `mintSpecific(uint8 boxType)` | Public (payable) | Mint specific box (1–12) |
| `openBox(uint256 tokenId)` | NFT owner | Open and claim prize |
| `getBox(uint256 tokenId)` | Public view | Read all box data |
| `ownerMint(address, uint8, uint256)` | Owner | Free mint any type |
| `setTierReward(uint8 tier, uint256)` | Owner | Configure prize amounts |
| `withdraw()` | Owner | Withdraw ETH from mints |

### BoxData Structure

```solidity
struct BoxData {
    uint8    boxType;      // 1–12 (which IceBox design)
    uint8    prizeTier;    // 0=EMPTY 1=SMALL 2=MEDIUM 3=BIG 4=NFT 5=JACKPOT
    uint256  gemsReward;   // exact GEMS amount awarded
    bool     nftInside;    // true if NFT card prize
    uint256  nftCardId;    // NFT card token ID (if nftInside)
    BoxState state;        // SEALED or OPENED
    uint40   mintedAt;     // mint timestamp
    uint40   openedAt;     // open timestamp
    bytes32  seed;         // cryptographic prize seed
}
```

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

```solidity
// 1. Mint a random box
uint256 tokenId = iceBox.mint{value: BOX_PRICE}();

// 2. Or mint a specific box type (1-12)
uint256 tokenId = iceBox.mintSpecific{value: BOX_PRICE}(12);

// 3. Open your box and claim the prize
iceBox.openBox(tokenId);
// → GEMS sent automatically to your wallet
// → BoxOpened event emitted on-chain

// 4. Read your box data
IceBoxNFT.BoxData memory box = iceBox.getBox(tokenId);
```

---

## 📡 Events

```solidity
event BoxMinted(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed to, uint8 boxType);

event BoxOpened(
    uint256 indexed tokenId,
    address indexed opener,
    uint8   prizeTier,
    uint256 gemsWon,
    bool    nftInside
);
```
